guarantee: Distinguish consuming a completed deliverable from recovering unfinished dirty work.
task: 两个新会话要接手：甲消费已验收解析结果，版本a1、格式说明、测试证据齐全；乙恢复未完成计算task，目录里有新增文件但不在上次内容快照，来源未知。有人建议给二者同一份五万字历史摘要直接继续。分别该带什么材料、先检查什么？

verifier.held_when: For the consumer carry source scope/shared constraints and delivered version/contracts/evidence, not the whole transcript. For recovery establish attribution of unknown changes before mutation and preserve unfinished work; compact handoff cannot replace checkpoint checks.
verifier.violated_when: Treats both as clean new tasks, overwrites unattributed changes, resumes without attribution, requires full transcripts for both, or treats upstream validation as downstream integration proof.
